title: Nebius Raises RAM Prices 41% and Adopts Dynamic AI Pricing

tickers.name: Nebius Group N.V. Class A Ordinary Shares

summary:
Costs to rent B300 and H100 GPUs climbed 21% and 17% this month at the AI infrastructure provider. Nebius is now utilizing an algorithm and auctions to determine prices based on existing demand, historical usage, and the price ranges customers are willing to set. On-demand list prices for RAM saw the steepest increase, rising about 41%.

Chief Revenue Officer Marc Boroditsky stated the company adopted the model after discovering that previous on-demand rates were too low. The transition to dynamic pricing changes the procurement process for AI compute, allowing the provider to adjust hardware rates based on current utilization and customer bids.
